points.description: Uses a one-vs-rest style approach: the function separates the feature vectors into one class versus all the remaining (rest) classes, i.e. a binary output (one class vs the rest).
points.partial_credit: Half if it only says the function classifies/separates classes without the one-versus-rest idea.

points.description: The process is repeated/iterated on the remaining data until all vectors (pixels) are classified into their classes.
points.partial_credit: Half if repetition is vaguely hinted at without saying it continues until all are classified.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the one-class-versus-rest idea (any wording) and the repetition until everything is classified. Give part marks for a vague but relevant answer, such as a function that splits the data into two groups. Give zero for unrelated answers.
